lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hello, this is Jordan, how can I help?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: I want to make a complaint. Your courier was extremely rude to me and threw the parcel at my door.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Okay. What is the order number?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Order five five one two. The box is damaged and nobody seems to care. I am very disappointed.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: I will pass the complaint to the delivery team.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Is that it? I expected an apology at least. This is terrible customer service.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: The delivery team will contact you.
